hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/bdk.mjs" hooks session-start 2>&1 || echo "BDK STOP: kernel unavailable (exit $?). Install Node >= 22.13 and run /bdk:setup."
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard/pre-tool.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] || { echo "guard/kernel-unavailable: $f is missing, so BDK cannot check this tool call; reinstall the BDK plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; . "$f"
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard/post-tool.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] || { echo "guard/kernel-unavailable: $f is missing, so BDK cannot check this agent; reinstall the BDK plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; . "$f"
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard/post-tool.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] || { echo "guard/kernel-unavailable: $f is missing, so BDK cannot check this agent; reinstall the BDK plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; . "$f"

f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard/prompt-expansion.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] || { echo "guard/kernel-unavailable: $f is missing, so BDK cannot check the stage gate; reinstall the BDK plugin" >&2; exit 2; }; . "$f"
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/bdk.mjs" hooks session-end 2>&1 || echo "BDK STOP: kernel unavailable (exit $?). Install Node >= 22.13 and run /bdk:setup."
